title: The network-home staging removal test passes silently where the administrative share is unreachable
outcome: The network-home staging removal test passes silently where the administrative share is unreachable
acceptance: When \\localhost\<drive>$ is unreachable, the Windows test of staging removal under a network home does not report a silent pass. It is either an explicit opt-in or ignored test, or it reports its skip in a form the gate shows.
